_note: Rewritten 2026-08-19 (routing follow-up, GH #1466) after the W2-2 demotion made a2ui-review-standards's description a wiring stub ('not a routing target'). No skill description can win a blind-router vote it explicitly refuses, so every case here expects no-trigger — the suite proves the demotion holds, not that the skill still has triggers. Each prompt's true owner is a neighboring skill or a dispatched agent seat; for a blind-router simulation a no-trigger case passes when anything but a2ui-review-standards wins, so no owner assertion is encoded in `expect` itself — the owner is recorded in each note for a human reading the matrix. eval_check's E5 case-mix warn (0 trigger / 10 no-trigger) on this suite is expected and accepted, not a defect to fix — ruled at PR #1471 ("eval_check E5 warn (0 trigger) is inherent to a wiring-only skill, accepted"); a future check-routing run should read this note rather than re-litigate the warn. Renamed from a2ui-review 2026-08-23 (audit-leftovers).
